a_09_00.scope: Exactly frozen r-existing objects. The original r subset is an identity-preserving subset of appended all-band members. Refit r and all on training-only detections; compare the same held observation only if both predictions give its same unique match. Common-source competition universe and 1arcsec gate explicitly condition these metrics. Bootstrap resamples physical sources using each source median radial held error, not individual repeated detections. Shared reference terms propagate between train and held groups; this is conditional position precision, not absolute PM truth.

b_16_00.coefficient_precision_note: A/D are actual float32 FITS 5E coefficients. Their half-ULP gives a possible constant great-circle-coordinate roundoff, not a target centroid error. Recentered residual is a diagnostic, not a new astrometric correction.
b_16_00.scope: Position-only reconstruction from published row/column, optical-distortion/DCR and affine coefficients; compares exact published per-band angular offsets. No proper-motion truth, no extra astrometric correction. Scalar r errors are not cloned.
b_16_00.native_error_scope: Centroid covariance assumes independent native row/column errors and fixed color; field MUERR/NUERR treated as great-circle coordinate errors in arcsec. Published r error ratios test the convention. Cross-band shared scan/calibration covariance and color-error propagation remain unverified.
b_16_00.adoption: Not approved for joint fitting yet: centroid/WCS covariance, shared-scan errors, per-band detection flags and independent held-object validation still required.
